checkpoint_rule: final fixed-budget checkpoint; root decides arm adoption from complete evidence
confirmation_selection_rule: The single advantage candidate advances only with positive completed-score/raw delta against legacy in BOTH development replicas, pooled gain >=25 points/raw, pooled mean played score >=legacy, and pooled completed-score/raw >uniform. Confirmation uses all three arms, 3 fresh replicas, 256 train and 128 eval each. No hyperparameter sweep. If development does not qualify, keep release state and legacy defaults.
decision_target: (chosen immediate merge gain-minimum legal gain)/(maximum legal gain-minimum legal gain); ties .5, illegal moves0. Pure pre-spawn slide; no future tiles, RNG calls or action substitution.
exposure_control: Uniform uses identical receipt shape and actual executed-line eligibility, with the same terminal episode reward assigned to each decision. Each local association averages its eligible decision targets and updates once per episode.
exposure_fairness: Arms share starting state, raw attempt budgets and environment/sample seeds. Each arm generates its own programs as learning proceeds; resulting episode lengths and traces may differ. No credit multiplier for repeated line events or total episode length.
generation_inputs: Code generation sees its learned state and corpus, not the board. Board/action information changes host learning targets after actual execution.
evidence_layout: Every measured attempt has an immutable per-index JSON receipt; completed phase JSONL is an atomic aggregation. Phase manifests bind every shard hash and exact count.
primary: completed episode score per raw generation attempt; incomplete episodes, failures and replay rejections count zero
interpretation: A generated-policy run includes novelty and syntax failures; fixed controls choose legal actions on every seed.
